action_args.justification: The series is strongly trend-dominated (trend strength 0.95) with weak seasonality (0.10) and non-stationary. The model ranking is only moderately stable (Kendall tau 0.446) across 3 validation windows, and the full pool contains one catastrophic outlier (RMSE 1784 vs median ~23). The median is robust to both the ranking instability and the outlier, while mean-based strategies on the full pool are destroyed by it. The pool-based means (pool2, pool3) achieve similar RMSE but the composite score does not distinguish them from the median. With the leader being a seed and the verdict 'indistinguishable', further tuning with only 3 windows risks overfitting to noise.
